selection_rule: Take the first three targets alphabetically from the paper campaign's frozen held-out validation split that have no SwiftScreen score or ranking outcome. Do not use published metric magnitude for selection.

primary_source.title: Vinardo: A Scoring Function Based on Autodock Vina Improves Scoring, Docking, and Virtual Screening

protocol.preparation: AutoDockTools prepare_receptor4.py and prepare_ligand4.py first; explicit Meeko fallback only after genuine ADT failure

prelaunch_gates: Reverify each S2/S3/S4 row directly against the primary supplementary workbooks.
Verify DUD archive counts, receptor PDB, bound ligand, and target/library-stem identity.
Freeze each crystal-ligand-derived box; do not reuse the ACE coordinates.
Generate and freeze target-specific ADT receptor and ligand preparation hashes on Tesla T4.
Confirm no target-specific preparation exception is required.
Render and statically validate target-specific T4 shards before any launch.
prohibitions: Do not inspect SwiftScreen outcomes before retaining or rejecting a selected target.
Do not tune protocol, margins, or ranking per target.
Do not launch from this preregistration alone.
